Bundled FFmpeg binary
=====================

The FFmpeg executable is injected by GitHub Actions at FPK build time.

Version: 7.0.2-static
Architecture: Linux x86_64
Source package used by the builder: imageio-ffmpeg==0.6.0
Static build provenance: https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/
Expected SHA256:
e7e7fb30477f717e6f55f9180a70386c62677ef8a4d4d1a5d948f4098aa3eb99

The final .fpk MUST contain app/native/vendor/ffmpeg.
fnOS installation does not download FFmpeg.
